name: open_pdf
description: Open a PDF in the on-screen HUD viewer. Use when the user wants to view, show, or display a PDF document.

parameters.description: The PDF location: a full https URL, a path under public (e.g. '/manual.pdf'), or an absolute file path on the user's computer (e.g. '/Users/me/document.pdf').
Optional short title for the widget header, e.g. 'USER MANUAL'. Omit if not specified by the user.
